_about: Rules for generating the Token Studio file from Supabase so token-bt comes out unchanged.
Input to the generator is ONLY the Supabase catalog + this file.
format rules: R1 colours literal lower-case hex/rgb; R1b transparent -> rgba(0,0,0,0); R2 opacity 0..1 -> percent;
R3 font-family strip quotes + fallback; R4 line-height emitted as stored (unitless); R5 semantic/component -> {ref} to mapped primitive path;
R6 elevation -> dropShadow composite from design_tokens_semantic_primitives, unthemed unless light/dark differ; R7 typography composite per design_token_families;
R8 literal; bare 0 -> 0px for px types; border-style -> {style, width:{border.width.xs}}
name_map: Supabase token -> Figma set/path (not derivable by rule).  families: family -> Figma composite path.
aliases: Figma paths that duplicate an existing Supabase token by value - emitted from that token, never added to Supabase.
figma_only: Figma needs these and Supabase has no source - emitted verbatim until added (status says what to add).
value_overrides: keep=figma -> Figma value emitted while Supabase still holds the recorded value (expires when Supabase is fixed); keep=supabase -> Figma value is wrong.
descriptions / extensions: carried verbatim into the export (they flow straight into Figma). Pipeline notes never go in a description.
Supabase tokens with no Figma path are emitted in their own supabase-only/<table> sets, never in a Figma set or theme.

CSS-only exception (agreed with Tina 2026-10-15): size.width.full / size.height.full (100%) and border-width.outline.solid (composite border) have no Figma variable type, so Tokens Studio drops them from Figma on sync. They stay in the token source for code; not bugs.
